name: Thrivenza Abandoned Cart Recovery
author: sproutient

sections.description:
thrivenza.com is the ultimate WooCommerce abandoned cart recovery plugin powered by AI.
Turn missed sales into revenue with smart, personalized abandoned cart recovery follow-ups.

Our advanced AI engine detects abandoned cart in real time and sends tailored abandoned cart recovery emails based on cart contents, customer behavior, and your brand’s unique tone. With Thrivenza’s abandoned cart recovery for WooCommerce, you don’t need to build workflows or write templates — just activate and let the abandoned cart recovery automation handle the rest.

Whether you’re running a small WooCommerce store or scaling a large eCommerce operation, recovering abandoned carts is critical. Thrivenza boosts your conversions, improves retention, and brings back lost customers — automatically.

Key Benefits of Thrivenza WooCommerce Abandoned Cart Recovery:

Detects abandoned cart and triggers recovery emails instantly.

Uses AI to craft personalized recovery emails — no templates needed.

Seamlessly integrates with WooCommerce stores.

Helps recover revenue and increase conversions around the clock.

Features:

AI-powered abandoned cart recovery for WooCommerce.

Automatically sends abandoned cart recovery emails based on cart behavior.

Easy setup — no complex abandoned cart recovery automation needed.

Converts lost carts into confirmed sales effortlessly.

External Services

This plugin connects to the thrivenza.com API to send automated cart recovery and review request emails.

This service is provided by “thrivenza.com”: terms of use, privacy policy.

CSS/JS source

Unminified CSS/JS are in assets/css/src and assets/js/src.
sections.installation:
Upload the Thrivenza abandoned cart recovery plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install via the WordPress Plugin Installer.

Activate the plugin through the 'Plugins' menu in WordPress.

Navigate to Dashboard > Thrivenza abandoned cart recovery to configure your Thrivenza API/Site key and enable abandoned cart recovery.
sections.faq:
How do I connect my thrivenza.com account?

Go to Dashboard > Thrivenza abandoned cart recovery, click the settings tab, and enter your Thrivenza API/Site key. This enables the plugin to send abandoned cart recovery emails via your Thrivenza account.

Do I need a thrivenza.com account to use this plugin?

Yes, an active thrivenza.com account with API access is required to use the abandoned cart recovery features.
